page: Microsoft Azure DC32eds_v6 is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine configuration built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Intel processor and provides 32 dedicated vCPUs alongside 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Designed for enterprise software deployments requiring both solid compute capacity and temporary high-speed I/O, the server operates without attached graphics accelerators.

Storage capabilities feature a bundled 1888 GB local NVMe SSD, providing fast scratch space, temporary indexing, and caching performance directly attached to the host. The instance is also compatible with Azure Premium Storage for external disk volumes. Network provisioning includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard Azure virtual networking infrastructure or assigned IP resources for external access.

With balanced compute-to-memory proportions and substantial integrated NVMe disk capacity, the DC32eds_v6 provides a cost-effective hardware balance for high-throughput enterprise applications without the overhead of dedicated accelerators. It is technically suited for mid-sized relational database hosting, large-scale caching tiers, continuous integration and build pipelines, and transactional enterprise web serving workloads.
